notes: Subtitles inside a video can finally be chosen. An .mkv from a rip carries several — the dialogue, the signs and songs, sometimes another language — and Rabbit could play none of them · The ⋯ sheet lists what the file actually holds, each named by its language in its own language, with what it is for beside it · Add a subtitle file… takes one from anywhere on the phone. It is copied next to the video, so it is still there next time and travels with the file if you move it · The × removes one you added, after asking. A track inside the video has no × — it is part of the video · The CC button now appears whenever there is anything to turn on, not only when a subtitle file was saved beside the video · Your choice is remembered for the site, like the quality and the VR layout
